items.title: Shoutout to this particular skeleton, who researchers believe is the first confirmed case of being totally obliterated by a trebuchet
items.summary: Mordre is so wlatsom and abhomynable.
items.body: One of the special pleasures in any medieval game is getting to field a trebuchet. In an era where warfare was largely a contest of who can keep people swinging their unfriendliest sticks around the longest before they get hungry enough to leave, there's a sort of giddiness that comes with being the guy who's weaponized the higher art of applied physics to fling half-ton boulders better than any run-of-the-mill onager could ever hope to. Sadly, there have in fact been real human beings who were unfortunate enough to be in the way of those boulders over the years, and as reported earlier this week by Science , researchers have identified a skeleton they believe could very well be the first confirmed trebuchet casualty in the archaeological record. (Image credit: Xbox Games Studios) The skeleton in question is Skeleton 150, one of a number of skeletons dating back to the 1300s that were unearthed during excavations beneath the chapel of Stirling Castle in Scotland in 1997. Skeleton 150 was one of five whose bones bore the evidence—cut marks, puncture wounds, blunt force trauma—of having died violently. items.body: Nightdive's System Shock remake is great. PC Gamer immsim guy Joshua Wolens gave it an 80% review score , and we later chose it as the Best Remake of 2023 in our annual Game of the Year awards. Three years down the road, Nightdive is following it up with System Shock VR, a VR game being developed by Flat2VR Studios. This is, going by the Steam description , a straight VR translation of the original game rather than a Half-Life: Alyx-style spinoff: You were caught hacking into TriOp, Edward Diego offered you a deal, you took it, and six months later that whole Citadel Station thing has kicked off. (If you have no idea what I'm talking about, go play System Shock. It's on sale for $15 on GOG and the Humble Store , if you insist on a Steam key.) items.title: This spy game is a dream come true if you love spending time in character creators
items.summary: And if your character isn't convincing enough, you die.
items.body: Are you someone who spends almost as much time creating your characters as you do playing them in an RPG? Love obsessing over the details of your avatar's facial features, browsing the menu of noses, eyes, ears, and facial hair for ages? Think you're good enough that you could make your character look so much like someone else that you could fool people? Good, because Legion Was Here is a game that spends more time in the character creator than it does anywhere else, and if you can't create a convincing character, you die. In Legion Was Here you're a spy. Scratch that: you're the spy. This game is the opposite of James Bond walking into every undercover situation and saying "Hi, I'm James Bond." You're gifted at stealing someone's identity and impersonating them down to the very finest detail, mimicking them so expertly that their friends, family, and associates will have no idea they're talking to an imposter. At least, that's the idea. Your mission begins on the operating table, where you page through a dossier of information about the person you're going to be replacing. items.title: If you're not paying attention to retro game recompilations, you're missing the most exciting thing in gaming right now
items.summary: Forget all the new games coming out in 2026. Newly shiny old games are where it's at.
items.body: In a few months, Nintendo will release a shiny remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Switch 2. Given its reputation as one of Nintendo's crown jewels, I imagine it will be remarkably faithful to the original, but with new graphics, some tweaks to the controls, and a few other modern touches—like the kinds we've been able to play Ocarina of Time with on PC since 2022 . Ocarina of Time's unofficial PC port Ship of Harkinian , developed by a group dedicated to reverse-engineering the Nintendo 64 game and painstakingly rewriting its code, has a built-in randomizer, accessibility options like text-to-speech, and literally hundreds of enhancements, from autosaving to tunable difficulty to ultrawide to high framerate support. There are options as granular as letting Link unsheathe his sword without attacking and disabling certain graphical effects so that they can be replaced with mods. Speaking of mods: There are hundreds of those , too, letting you use the character models from the 2011 3DS port, make the UI HD, or play as Wario if you're freaky like that. "We’re especially excited about the momentum we’re seeing with cloud games and kids games." Unhinged, as I mentioned, was developed by Night School and released just six weeks ago, on June 30. items.summary: يتجه ليفربول وآرسنال، إلى لجنة تحكيم، بعد فشلهما في التوصل إلى اتفاق بشأن قيمة التعويض المستحق عن اللاعب الشاب فينسنت جوزيف، البالغ من العمر 16 عامًا.
items.body: يتجه ليفربول وآرسنال، إلى لجنة تحكيم، بعد فشلهما في التوصل إلى اتفاق بشأن قيمة التعويض المستحق عن اللاعب الشاب فينسنت جوزيف، البالغ من العمر 16 عامًا. وذكرت صحيفة الديلي ميل ، أن جوزيف، الذي شارك مع فريق ليفربول تحت 18 عامًا، غادر الريدز، الشهر الماضي، رغم أن النادي عرض على اللاعب، الحصول على منحة دراسية، وكان يتعين توقيعها بحلول الأول من يوليو. ورفض اللاعب، العرض، في ظل اهتمام عدد من الأندية، من بينها مانشستر يونايتد وتشيلسي وبايرن ميونخ وبوروسيا دورتموند. لكن آرسنال، بطل الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، هو من نجح في حسم السباق، للحصول على توقيع فينسنت جوزيف. ومنذ ذلك الحين، دخل آرسنال في مفاوضات مع ليفربول بشأن قيمة التعويض، لكن الناديين لم يتمكنا من التوصل إلى أرضية مشتركة.  وفي ظل حالة الجمود الحالية، أصبح الطرفان في طريقهما إلى لجنة تحكيم لتحديد قيمة التعويض المستحق للريدز. وكان آخر لاعب مراهق يغادر ليفربول، للانضمام إلى نادٍ آخر في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، هو إسحاق موران.

items.summary: هل يرحل النجم السعودي عن الهلال؟
items.body: هل يرحل النجم السعودي عن الهلال؟ اشتعلت حالة من الجدل حول إمكانية رحيل علي البليهي، مدافع الهلال إلى الأهلي أو الدرعية، بعد الظهور المفاجئ لشقيقه في مباراة الليلة. وحقق الأهلي فوزًا صعبًا أمام الدرعية، بهدف دون رد، مساء الخميس، ضمن الجولة الأولى من بطولة دوري روشن. اقرأ أيضًا..فيديو.. كواليس أول لقاء بين رونالدو وبوستيكوجلو في النصر وشهدت مدرجات الأهلي حضور شقيق علي البليهي، وهو ما تسبب في حالة من الجدل، حول إمكانية انتقال نجم الهلال إلى أحد الناديين. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ! ولكن شقيق البليهي ظهر في لقاء تلفزيوني عبر برنامج "دورينا غير" للحديث عن الأمر، قائلًا: "أنا مشجع للأهلي منذ فترة طويلة وأحضر المباريات". وأكمل: "اعتدت دائمًا أن أحضر أولى مباريات الأهلي في الموسم، وكنت متواجدًا في لقاء النصر والراقي الأخير". وأتم: "هذه هي طبيعة كرة القدم، كل طرف يشجع ما يريد، وأنا أحب الأهلي كثيرًا". ولم تكن هذه هي المرة الأولى التي يظهر فيها شقيق البليهي خلاال مباريات الأهلي، حيث سبق وأن خطف الأنظار في مواجهة الهلال والراقي خلال الموسم قبل الماضي.

items.summary: دخلت صفقة انتقال رودري نجم مانشستر سيتي، إلى صفوف برشلونة، مراحلها الأخيرة.
items.body: دخلت صفقة انتقال رودري نجم مانشستر سيتي، إلى صفوف برشلونة، مراحلها الأخيرة. وحتى الآن، لا يوجد اتفاق بين برشلونة ومانشستر سيتي، لكن جميع الأطراف تأمل في التوصل لاتفاق خلال الأيام المقبلة، حتى يتمكن رودري من الانتقال إلى ملعب سبوتيفاي كامب نو. وكان من المقرر أن تنتهي عطلة اللاعب، اليوم الخميس، على أن ينضم صباح الجمعة إلى تدريبات مانشستر سيتي. لكن صحيفة " سبورت " أكدت أن رودري، طلب الحصول على إذن خاص، لعدم السفر إلى إنجلترا، من أجل الانتظار حتى انتهاء المفاوضات بين الناديين. وتدور رغبة رودري، حول انتظار برشلونة، على أمل أن يتم حل الفارق المالي البسيط المتبقي بين الناديين، حتى يبدأ العمل تحت قيادة المدرب هانز فليك. ويرى اللاعب، أنه قد لا يحضر التدريب، من أجل منح المفاوضات، المزيد من الوقت حتى يتم حسم كل شيء، لكنه سيفعل ذلك فقط بموافقة مانشستر سيتي، وإذا لم يسمح له النادي الإنجليزي بذلك، فسوف يحضر اللاعب إلى التدريبات.  وفي الواقع، كان رودري لا يزال في مدريد حتى اليوم الخميس، وشوهد وهو يتناول الطعام في مطعم كاسا لامبازاس. وكان إنزو ماريسكا قد أكد أن اللاعب سيكون في مانشستر، يوم الجمعة، لكن رودري يأمل في الحصول على هذا الإذن الخاص من ناديه.

items.title: Beast of Reincarnation director apologizes for not providing 'a sufficiently enjoyable experience,' but promises Game Freak is working on it
items.summary: The response to Game Freak's post-apocalyptic action RPG has not been universally positive.
items.body: Game Freak's Beast of Reincarnation arrived earlier this month, and the reaction has been a little iffy. It holds a respectable 73/100 aggregate score on Metacritic —lining up quite nicely with our own 73% review —but the response on Steam is "mixed," with many user reviews expressing some variation of "close, but not quite." And for that, game director Kota Furushima is sorry. "I honestly feel that there are still areas in the game that require our sincere attention," Furushima said in an interview with 4Gamer (via Automaton ). "I’m truly sorry that parts of the game haven't provided a sufficiently enjoyable experience." Furushima acknowledged that some elements of the game "need polishing," and said that more updates, following the first on August 9, are on the way to address issues with story pacing, add frame generation, and give players the option to skip cutscenes. It doesn't sound like changes to the game's difficulty are too high on the priority list, though: Furushima said his intent wasn't to make Beast of Reincarnation a particularly difficult game, but simply to ensure players needed to work effectively with Koo, the Blight-infected canine companion, in order to succee…

It's a classy device, particularly as you can swap out the magnetic faceplates to your taste. I've seen some fairly tasteful designs so far, but none more OTT than this marble version from redditor GinoWT . The marble used is supposedly from the Carrara quarry basin, which is the one Michelangelo worked from. I know absolutely nothing about marble, but some searching suggests that the old master did indeed use marble from this region . I cut a Steam Machine faceplate from the same marble Michelangelo used from r/steammachine As for this stuff specifically? Yeah, I'll take a hard pinch of salt with that one. It all looks the same to me—but I am, of course, a classless heathen of the lowest regard. Anyway, GinoWT says they usually cut marble for superyacht materials, so they've got the workshop setup to make square plates of the stuff . But aside from the sentimental concerns—which, honestly, I don't hold as any less important, there's more to life than money—there is a capitalist argument against the move, too, for both the consumer and the people who make videogames. If Sony ends physical disk sales, Sony decides how much a game on the PlayStation costs, forever. Such is the argument of one Dutch consumer group that's currently suing Sony for their proposed changes, stating last month that "no discs means no second-hand market and no alternative to the PlayStation Store, so from 2028, Sony alone decides what a game costs and even how long you are allowed to use it." At the very least, despite Steam's monolithic popularity, Valve's not capable of forcing anybody to use it. You can still use GOG or Itch.io or… Epic, if you really wanted to. items.title: It looks like Windows updates might actually be speeding up the OS now
items.summary: Less AI, more performance improvements: I'm here for it.
items.body: We've been hearing for quite some time that Microsoft is planning on making changes to Windows 11 that focus on performance, quality-of-life, and just actually good things. Rather than, y'know, AI gubbins almost nobody was asking for. And now, according to Windows Latest , the most recent update for Windows 11 includes a feature that's supposed to make apps launch quicker. The 'low latency profile' launched earlier in the year but it now apparently covers apps in addition to Windows elements such as the Start menu. This feature essentially allows the scheduler to have the CPU boost up to fast speeds and drop down again quicker, which is good for short burst tasks like opening apps. You should get this feature automatically with the latest Windows 11 KB5121003, build 26200.9168 / 26100.9168 update, and you can check whether it's working by keeping an eye on your CPU clock speed and seeing whether it boosts up near max in software like HWInfo . This isn't the only useful update we've seen for Windows 11 in recent weeks. Although initially just for Insiders, recent improvements to the Start menu look promising. items.title: Amazon drops Lost Ark and Throne and Liberty
items.summary: Both MMOs will continue to operate, but new publishers are taking over in the West.
items.body: Amazon's big MMO era has taken its last gasp, as the company is ending its publishing deals for both Throne and Liberty and Lost Ark . The games themselves will continue, however: NC will take over Throne and Liberty for Western markets near the end of 2026, while Smilegate will do the same for Lost Ark in early 2027. Little should change for players as a result of the handoffs, although a small number of details on the Throne and Liberty changeover are still being hammered out and will be announced closer to the actual transition. On the Lost Ark side, some user data will not make the transfer , including in-game mail, friends list memos and group names, guild member nicknames and memos, and chat messages and history. The games themselves will continue to operate as they always have and will receive regular content updates leading up to the changeover, although Throne and Liberty developer FirstSpark Games warned that major updates may be held back until the transition is complete. Swinging the axe on Lost Ark and Throne and Liberty is pretty much the final nail in the coffin containing Amazon's once-lofty gaming ambitions. items.title: Sony has 'zero understanding for what their customers want' says gaming preservation group
items.summary: With Sony ending disc support, many fear what that means for game preservation going forward.
items.body: PC gamers may have watched physical game discs disappear years ago, but there's a battleground happening over in console land right now. A big one. And it might only be getting more contentious as time ticks on. With Sony ending support for physical discs in the near future , and the heads of Ubisoft and Take Two seemingly not caring very much, you might think the end of physical game media is not far off. Yet there exists a growing movement to push back against this trend. I had a chance to chat to Clemens Istel, the owner of game preservation site Does It Play , about this movement. He tells me, "Customer rights are almost non-existent in the gaming space, and companies have proven time and time again that honest communication is not their strong suit." Does It Play is both a physical games media advocacy group and a database dedicated to documenting which games can be played without a download or offline. Istel is also part of the team behind Stop Killing Games . items.body: Marvel Tōkon—the all-out 4v4 tag fighter from 2D fighting game veteran ArcSystem Works—didn't get off on the best foot with PC players. Forced PSN logins and frame drops that were leading to a whopping eight frames of rollback in online modes saw the game launch to "Mixed" reviews, before eventually tanking to "Mostly Negative" over the weekend. And while there's zero chance of the PSN stuff going away, ArcSys has at least been speedy about trying to tackle those pesky frame drops. A patch earlier this week has done the bulk of the work on optimising performance, leaving the game a helluva lot smoother for it. items.body: A slight bastion of hope for those affected by the memory crisis (ie, anyone who wants to buy new electronics in the next few years) is the planned arrival of new fabrication facilities, pumping out vast amounts of wafers that will be turned into memory modules. According to Micron, though, we shouldn't hold our breath. Sumit Sadana, the executive vice president and chief business officer of Micron, spoke at a tech and finance forum earlier this week . According to Sadana: "All of this growth in [AI server-critical] HBM pressures the supply that is left for everything else, which means that the wafer supply has to increase dramatically, and that is just not easy to do." "It takes a long time because the whole industry got itself into a state where most of that expansion needed to be done in greenfield expansion," Sadana continued. items.title: Welcome to the internet in 2026, where AI agents are both victim and attacker in malware wars
items.summary: Let's hope safeguards develop in-line with AI agent capabilities.
items.body: It might feel like an eternity that we've been living in this AI era, but really we're only at its advent. As such, many of the risks associated with it have until now been merely hypothetical. However, we're now seeing research filter out from security and software research teams that show some genuinely concerning behaviour, in particular when it comes to AI agents. On the one hand, we have Island Technology explaining how it's uncovered thousands of malicious GitHub repos disguised as AI agent skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that the agents are at risk of downloading of their own discretion. On the other hand, we have the AI Security Institute (AISI) showing how the (unrestricted) AI agents it was using for cybersecurity attempted to dupe real people, using fake identities and pressuring people into accepting malicious code. I remember when OpenClaw ('Moltbot', back then) first entered public consciousness with promises of actual agential behaviour to help solopreneurs and the likes do, umm, stuff and things. Unfortunately, eight years is a long time—and as Kanohi said back then, "the Lego Group's stance on fan-created media has changed." Fans became aware of the desecration of Dobby's memorial after a BBC interview with project manager Simon Ludlam, who detailed plans to put the cable underground at Freshwater West beach in Wales (via The Guardian ). This just happens to be the location where Dobby's fictional death was shot for Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 , and the site of a fan-made shrine.
